description: Submit an entry to a custom form — creates a matter/contact and fires the form's automations, exactly like a website submission. Standard keys: first_name, last_name, email, phone. Custom fields use the key form 'custom_field_<id>' (IDs from get-form or list-custom-fields). utm_source/utm_campaign/utm_medium/utm_term are also accepted.

data.description: Field values keyed by field ID, e.g. {"first_name": "Jane", "custom_field_2263": "yes"}.

name: submit-form
